title: In 2018, Jon Bon Jovi paid $10 million for a Palm Beach home, demolished it and rebuilt; 2 years later
summary_full: Jon Bon Jovi recently sold his exquisite Palm Beach residence for nearly $20 million, a significant increase from the $10 million he initially invested in the land. On the same day, he invested $43 million in a lavish oceanfront property extending over 10,000 square feet, featuring high-end amenities such as a swimming pool and private courtyard. This move underlines the increasing demand for luxury real estate in Palm Beach.
